$comment: The capability vocabulary channels are graded against. `requires` encodes functional dependency: a channel cannot grant filesystem_write without filesystem_read, nor either without tool_use - a model with no tool harness cannot touch a disk no matter what it claims. Missions derive their required set from MissionConstraints (lib/dispatch/capability.py); the dispatcher refuses a channel that cannot serve it.

data.label: Text Generation
data.description: Accepts a prompt and returns generated text. The floor - every channel has it.

data.label: System Prompt Channel
data.description: Honors a system/persona message distinct from the user turn. Without it the composed agent persona must be inlined into the prompt body, which weakens instruction adherence.

data.label: Tool Use
data.description: Model can emit structured tool/function calls AND the channel runtime executes them. Declaring this on a bare completion endpoint is the classic error: the model may emit a call, but nothing runs it.

data.label: Filesystem Read
data.description: The runtime can open files on the target host and feed them back to the model. Without it, any 'analyze this codebase' task is answered from imagination.

data.label: Filesystem Write
data.description: The runtime can create and modify files on the target host.

data.label: Shell Execution
data.description: The runtime can execute shell commands on the target host and return their output.

data.label: Network Egress
data.description: The runtime can fetch remote URLs or query the web on the model's behalf.

data.label: Structured Output
data.description: Response can be constrained to JSON or a supplied schema.

data.label: Streaming Response
data.description: Tokens arrive incrementally rather than in one settled payload.

data.label: Session Persistence
data.description: Multi-turn state is retained by the channel across calls rather than re-sent each time.

data.label: Subagent Spawn
data.description: The runtime can spawn nested agents of its own. Fan-out multiplies both cost and the identity sprawl the agency exists to track.
